policy.focus: Second-pass expansion for Japanese English learners, emphasizing everyday concrete nouns, British English, household vocabulary, police/institutional vocabulary, and culturally opaque expressions.
policy.meaning: Neutral dictionary Japanese; single words use POS headings.
policy.inThisPlay: Only when materially context-dependent, polysemous, idiomatic, ironic, culturally specific, or historically specific.
policy.existing: Preserve all existing line vocabulary and dictionary entries; never duplicate an existing surface on the same speech.
policy.source: Canonical dialogue only; stage-direction-only matches must not create line vocabulary or dictionary entries.
